usage: yandex-direct-health.py [-h] [--write] [--format {md,json}] [config]

Report Yandex Direct readiness without making API calls.

positional arguments:
  config              Path to seo-cycle.yaml

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit
  --write             Write seo/setup/yandex-direct-health.* artifacts.
  --format {md,json}
